title: delphinium exaltatum var. californicum
intro: Delphinium exaltatum var. californicum, commonly known as California Larkspur, is a perennial plant native to the western United States. It is known for its tall spikes of blue or white flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The plant has been reported to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in treating wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of California Larkspur include delphinine, a toxic alkaloid, as well as other alkaloids and glycosides, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative and antispasmodic effects.
